summary: Root owns complete recovery joins and current owning-issue reconciliation; Home retains durable baseline custody and same-PR adoption. A private recovered successor unavailable from protected source needs its actual closed packet and independently matching bounded Host restore outside managed documentation/disposable roots before adoption. Unavailable original bytes and receipts remain unavailable. Compose actual roles, receiving identities, wrappers/entrypoints, source/tool pins and selected operator lifetime early; exercise a meaningful joined source path, then one frozen-whole independent review. Component counts and older passes do not qualify a different candidate, publication or native effects. Missing enrollment withholds board-derived selection, while separately authorized issue/PR source and qualified scope-snapshot Status maintenance can continue under their own guards. Preserve the first content-hash failure and repair an isolated cache with verified feeds and unchanged locks, never a global purge or weaker verification. Before return/handoff reconcile the existing owning issue from current channel evidence, distinguishing reported supply, independent byte/source verification, scoped accepted delivery and remaining promises. These corrections add no duplicate ledger, ordinary-Git packet gate or review chain; savings are unmeasured. Source guidance delivery does not establish installed consumer adoption.
title: Recover private custody and compose actual interfaces before acceptance
